rows.name: S3\* that reads what S1 wrote
rows.summary: the auditor runs the suite the unit edited

rows.reproducedBy: the self-certifier behaviour; the `no-inherited-tests` arm shows it closing green
rows.notAbsorbed: an expectation rewritten to the current output inside an exempt file (`inherited-tests-check` limitation 1)

rows.name: S5 collapsed into S3
rows.summary: identity is whatever the last operator or unit wrote
rows.looksLike: A unit edits `regulator/identity/`, or a README rule becomes policy nobody decided
rows.reproducedBy: the drifter, which edits the glossary and is refused, and the sloppy unit, which writes rules into the README (DEBT row 34 is paid by `glossary-lint`; the README rule itself is still only measured, by `memoryRules`)
rows.notAbsorbed: a rule written in prose outside the writable prefixes shows up as a grader's number; no check refuses it

rows.name: No S4
rows.summary: nothing watches the environment, so the system learns of change by failing
rows.looksLike: A dependency advisory, a platform change or a new statement is found by a unit mid-work, or never

notes: in the finance workload, nothing yet

rows.notAbsorbed: S4 triggers that would raise a research unit unasked (archived CONTROL-REGISTRY.md §7); in the finance example a statement's arrival is handled by hand

rows.name: Missing recursion
rows.summary: the harness is regulated only as a tool, never as a viable system of its own
rows.looksLike: Nobody owns a regulator, review dates pass, and the definition drifts from the instances

regulators.note: a passed review date fails CI

rows.reproducedBy: `regulator check --today 2027-01-01`, which makes every card overdue
rows.notAbsorbed: the definition's own S4 (the Pi upgrade path) is a checklist a person runs

rows.name: S2 absorbed by S3
rows.summary: every coordination is an orchestrator decision
rows.looksLike: Units serialize behind the loop, and a conflict becomes a replan instead of a signal

notes: leases and worktrees coordinate without S3, and a conflict is a coordination signal

rows.name: S3 overload / micromanagement

rows.notAbsorbed: the metrics that would show it (undelegated decisions discovered, replans attributable to the contract) are DEBT row 40

rows.name: S3/S4 disconnection

rows.notAbsorbed: an advisory nobody ever dispositions holds its units forever (a wait ceiling is DEBT row 30's sibling)

rows.name: Weak S5 / no algedonic path
rows.summary: nothing can interrupt the loop
rows.looksLike: A unit spends its ceiling on a question a person could have answered in a minute, or it asks about everything

rows.reproducedBy: the recovery cases in `controller.test.ts`, and the drifter's `repair → repair → replan`

rows.name: Budget without a limit behaviour
rows.summary: the ceiling is reached and nothing happens
rows.looksLike: A unit runs until the provider cuts it off
rows.notAbsorbed: a reserve for verification and recovery at the instance level is not declared (the viability-theory framing; unscheduled)

rows.name: Recovery per unit hides a shared cause
rows.summary: the same failure is recovered once per unit, and the instance never notices
rows.looksLike: Six units each take `environment → remediate` for one missing dependency, six decisions and no signal

notes: nothing at the instance level: `recovery-router` counts occurrences per cause per unit by design (its limitation 3), and `progression-veto` holds progression only on an obligation something else opened

rows.reproducedBy: none; a fixture whose tool fails identically for every unit would show it
rows.notAbsorbed: a level-2 count over recovery decisions that opens an obligation on the instance when N units hit one cause in a window (the [agent-engineering books note](https://github.com/MetaCoding-io/regulator/blob/main/docs/research/2026-10-25-agent-engineering-books.md) §4 item 8, after Lanham §8.3.7's circuit breaker); recorded as a backlog row, not debt, because the card names the per-unit count as a limit

rows.name: The undeclared action
rows.summary: the domain's irreversible act reaches the harness as a write prefix and an advice line, so whether it needs a yes is the model's to notice
rows.looksLike: A trade list, a payment or a publish is a file the unit writes under a prefix the profile allows; the advice says to ask first, and a hurried unit writes without asking, or asks once per item until the person stops reading

regulators.note: the action is a tool the workload declares with its effect, and the consent is derived from `sideEffects: "irreversible"` before the call runs
a consent grant on a path prefix where no tool is declared

rows.reproducedBy: the portfolio's careless close (`portfolio.test.ts`): `place_trade` called without asking is refused by the derived consent, the tree unchanged
rows.notAbsorbed: the derivation reads one value of one axis, and an irreversibility outside the tree (a network call the program makes) is declared, not observed (`declared-tool` limitations 2 and 4)

rows.name: Channel without transduction
rows.summary: a signal is not an audit, and an audit is not a policy
rows.looksLike: A finding is filed as a proposal, or an uncertainty is treated as a decision

notes: typed channels with authority per kind (the `reporting` tools)

the turn and token ceilings end the attempt eventually
what the loop needs survives eviction
